title: Social Performance & Intimacy
description: Map the friction of being seen. Discover if your social fatigue is driven by judgment fear or sensory overwhelm.

questions.text: Before a social event, the dominant thought is...

options.text: I wonder who will be there.
I hope I don't look awkward.
I need to plan 'safe' topics to talk about.
How can I get out of this without people hating me?

questions.text: During a group conversation, I am usually...

options.text: Listening and contributing easily.
Conscious of my posture or tone, but engaged.
Monitoring every word I say for potential 'mistakes'.
Mentally absent; I am too panicked to follow the thread.

questions.text: When I make a small social mistake (e.g., mispronouncing a word), I feel...

options.text: A bit embarrassed, then I laugh it off.
Annoyed at myself.
Convinced everyone is now judging me.
A wave of heat/shame so intense I need to leave.

insight_cloud.title: Spotlight Effect
insight_cloud.text: We tend to believe others are noticing our flaws way more than they actually are. This is the 'Spotlight Effect'. In reality, most people are too busy worrying about their own spotlight to see yours.

options.text: Energized or normally tired.
Exhausted and needing alone time.
Regretful, replaying my 'cringe' moments.
Profoundly depleted and 'socially hungover' for days.

questions.text: Have you ever experienced physical avoidance symptoms (nausea, dizziness) just at the thought of a social interaction?

options.text: No.
Once or twice.
Frequently.
Yes, I am effectively housebound due to this.
